titel: Draft Commission guidance on the Cyber Resilience Act
titel_en: Draft Commission guidance on the Cyber Resilience Act
samenvatting: The European Commission is preparing a Communication that will provide guidance on how to apply the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) in practice. The guidance will help manufacturers, developers, and other stakeholders understand their obligations under the Regulation and ensure a consistent approach across the EU. It will clarify how key provisions of the CRA should be interpreted and implemented. Stakeholders are encouraged to submit their comments to this consultation by using the attached template, in order to facilitate feedback consolidation.
